nextStoryContext: US-004 likely adds cam-cli subcommands (cam claude / cam retry-monitor) that invoke startMonitor from src/retry/monitor.ts. The processOneTick(state, pane, deps) signature is stable — callers pass a TickDeps object. Bun.spawn stdout pattern: `new Response(proc.stdout).text()`. Monitor entry: bun src/retry/monitor.ts <pane> <pid>. isDirectRun guard checks process.argv[1]?.endsWith('monitor.ts').

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.spawn(cmd, { stdout: 'pipe' }) returns Subprocess with .stdout: ReadableStream and .exited: Promise<number>. new Response(proc.stdout).text() is idiomatic. Bun.spawnSync returns SyncSubprocess with .stdout: Buffer | undefined. Implementation confirmed matches API.
